title: Roots of Unity Unit Circle
description: N twiddle factors plotted as evenly spaced points on the unit circle with a synchronized table of exact complex values, for N of 4, 8, 16, or 32.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
FFT
Complex Analysis

educational.topic: Roots of unity as FFT twiddle factors
learningObjectives: Calculate twiddle factor values for a chosen N
Demonstrate that the roots are evenly spaced on the unit circle
Identify the roots requiring no general multiplication

controls.label: Any point on the circle
controls.purpose: Select that root and highlight its table row

simulationModel.modelType: Direct evaluation of the roots of unity
equations: W_N^k = e^(-i*2*pi*k/N) = cos(-2 pi k / N) + i sin(-2 pi k / N)
assumptions: Forward-transform sign convention, giving clockwise advance
limitations: Shows the factors themselves; how they are indexed per FFT stage is covered in the stage sims

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Paired geometric and numeric views for verification
keyQuestions: Why do the points advance clockwise rather than counterclockwise?
Which roots need no real multiplication?
commonMisconceptions: That twiddle factors are an exotic new kind of number
That the sign of the exponent does not matter because magnitudes are unaffected
assessmentOpportunities: State W_16^4 in rectangular form and describe its geometric action
